statistical_scope.interpretation: Paired descriptive audit of the already evaluated cue-repair holdout; no new generalization or significance claim.

comparison_controls.note: Same recorded input/executor identities with measured unequal costs; this historical protocol is not a new strict total-budget-matched experiment. Exact KV here maps exact request strings to skills, not the separate factual-memory task.

training_and_selection.linear_reader: 128-to-12, same initialization for LoRA and frozen linear control
training_and_selection.lexical_features: TFIDF word unigrams/bigrams plus char_wb 2-5 grams
training_and_selection.selection: V13 calibration executed task success, then label accuracy, then earliest candidate; never new holdout outcomes.

protocol.task_scope: Instruction-to-skill selection and explicitly decomposed composition; no claim of algorithm synthesis, learned planning, arbitrary new fact memory, or open-domain generality.
protocol.information: All selectors receive the identical raw request text and V13 train/calibration examples. Payloads go to the identical shared executor. No selector receives skill labels, expected outputs, project-to-label maps, or holdout metadata.

unknown_prior_entries.source: Original V13 report does not expose a complete consolidated historical exploration total; not charged as zero.

other_unmeasured_costs: dependency install/checkout/preservation and other CI overhead
distributed transport/migration and actual device energy
research_cost.accounting_note: Repeated prior ledger counted once. Internal run wall is nested inside subprocess wall, not additive. Retained bytes include source, base and every candidate checkpoint; deployment arm sums charge a shared encoder separately.

conclusion: All three prespecified candidates remain below the strongest measured baseline under the original quality and utility protocol. This audit adds provenance/arithmetic checks, not new model quality or long-term stability evidence.
